title: ICAI President CA Prasanna Kumar D Elected to IFAC Board: A Proud Moment!
content:
# ICAI President CA Prasanna Kumar D Elected to IFAC Board: A Proud Moment!

Ek important update hai! Humare Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) ke esteemed President, CA Prasanna Kumar D, ko International Federation of Accountants (IFAC) Board ke liye chun liya gaya hai. This is indeed a proud moment for the entire Indian accountancy profession!

Here are the key details:

*   **What:** CA Prasanna Kumar D, currently the President of ICAI, has been elected as a Board member of the International Federation of Accountants (IFAC).
*   **When:** His appointment to the IFAC Board is effective from November 21, 2026.
*   **Term:** He will serve a three-year term, spanning from November 2026 to November 2029.
*   **Support Role:** ICAI's Vice-President, CA Mangesh Kinare, will join him as his Technical Advisor on the IFAC Board, further strengthening India's representation.
*   **Significance:** This election highlights India's growing influence and crucial contribution to shaping global accounting standards, professional practices, and financial governance at an international level. It's a testament to the calibre of Indian Chartered Accountants and ICAI's leadership.
